newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER FRITZ STROBL.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER FRITZ STROBL.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of the World Cup Finals downhill race on Wednesday:
World Cup wins: 3; Downhills at Val d'Isere (1996),

Strobl joined Austrian team in 1990 but a knee injury forced him to the "B" team where he competed in the Europa Cup. The skier, who comes from the southern Austrian region that produced the great Franz Klammer, broke through in the first race of his first full World Cup season at Val d'Isere, won the most prestigious race in the middle at Kitzbuehel and then won the last race of the season at the World Cup Finals in Vail.
